## Runs 6–7 — raw field cuts, then oscillation analysis (plan step 3)

Data/6 is the electron cut at nominal n=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D=0; data/7 is the hole cut at nominal n=−1.2×10¹² cm⁻². Below, raw voltage/current/leakage precede signed measured-current R and FFT windows. The density scale is still geometry-anchored; the run-5 CNP slope is empirical. No new hardware access occurs here.

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_onset, sdh_fft
root = Path.cwd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(3,2,figsize=(12,9))
traces=[]
for j,rid in enumerate((6,7)):
 r=open_run(root/'data'/str(rid)); cs=resolve_channels(r.meta); ci=current_channel(cs); cv=next(c for c in cs if c.cid=='sr1')
 B=r.col('magnet_field'); I=r.col(ci.col)/ci.gain; R=(r.col(cv.col)/cv.gain)/I
 ax[0,j].plot(B,r.col(cv.col)*1e6); ax[0,j].set_ylabel('raw sr1 X (uV)')
 ax[1,j].plot(B,I*1e9); ax[1,j].set_ylabel('drain I (nA)')
 for c in ('k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr'): ax[2,j].plot(B,r.col(c)*1e12,label=c)
 ax[2,j].legend(fontsize=7); ax[2,j].set_ylabel('gate I (pA)'); ax[2,j].set_xlabel('B (T)'); ax[0,j].set_title(f'data/{rid}')
 print(f'RUN {rid}: R signed {R.min():.2f}..{R.max():.2f} Ohm, current {I.min()*1e9:.3f}..{I.max()*1e9:.3f} nA; T {r.col("T_sample").min():.3f}..{r.col("T_sample").max():.3f} K; max gate {max(np.max(np.abs(r.col(c))) for c in ("k_2400_tg_curr","k_2400_bg_curr"))*1e12:.1f} pA')
 traces.append((rid,B,R))
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(root/'hera_scratch/spot_raw.png',dpi=140); plt.show()
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(12,7))
for j,(rid,B,R) in enumerate(traces):
 ax[0,j].plot(B,R,lw=0.8); ax[0,j].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='signed V/I (Ohm)',title=f'data/{rid}')
 for lo in (1,2,3):
  f,spec=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(lo,10),log=False,nfft=4096,bg_degree=3)
  ax[1,j].plot(f,spec[0]/spec[0].max(),label=f'{lo}-10 T')
 ax[1,j].set(xlim=(0,65),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='normalized FFT'); ax[1,j].legend()
 try:
  onset=sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000,b_lo=0.3)
  print(f'RUN {rid} onset:\n{onset.summary()}')
 except ValueError as e: print(f'RUN {rid} onset unresolved: {e}')
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(root/'hera_scratch/spot_sdh.png',dpi=140); plt.show()
r=open_run(root/'data/5'); times=r.col('time').reshape(63,66); inner=np.diff(times,axis=1); turn=times[1:,0]-times[:-1,-1]
print('Run 5 timing: within-row median / p95',np.quantile(inner,[.5,.95]),'turn median / p95',np.quantile(turn,[.5,.95]))

**Read / next (plan steps 3→4):** data/6 has signed R=−32.95…529.63 Ω and I=9.843…9.935 nA; data/7 has R=−0.38…586.87 Ω and I=9.809…9.931 nA. Maximum absolute gate current is 123.4/215.8 pA, respectively; T=1.165…1.292 K across both. Neither voltage trace clips (50 µV range). Preserve negative minima rather than rectifying them. FFT peak positions/weights depend on field window; onset-helper candidates include electron 7.1/14.1/22.1/29.5 T and hole 6.6/9.4/12.3 T, with harmonic and residual flags. The electron 0.30 T onset is censored and not a measured die-off; interpolation of coarse low-B points can also exaggerate significance. These are candidate oscillatory components, not independent Fermi surfaces or a stacking determination.

A density–field fan is warranted to distinguish crossing families from harmonics or a translated second neutrality ridge. Run 5's two ridges do not prove two spatial regions or a common stacking template; the prior ana interpretation of a “series mosaic” and a physically fixed D=0 is provisional. Only B_1–B_2 is measured; there is no Hall pair or separate region readout. Nominal D=0 is the resistance-symmetry estimate. The next fan preserves gate axes and tests the absolute density prior where a filling sequence can be identified without circularly assuming stacking.

## HERA — Landau fan across both carrier signs (plan step 4)

> **05:22** · Landau fan B\_1-B\_2: B=0 then 1-10 T/0.2 T; n\_geom=-1.2..3.2e12/0.02, Dnom=0; 47x221; base T; Si=0; 3 s dwell · **ETA ~16:22** (≈11h)

Runs 6/7 establish oscillatory transport on B_1–B_2 (R −33…530 / −0.4…587 Ω; drain current 9.81…9.94 nA; maximum |gate current| 0.216 nA). The multiple spectral components cannot distinguish band branches from harmonics or the second CNP ridge in run 5. This fan follows the run-5 nominal D=0 line through both neutrality features to resolve branch crossings and density dependence for the ABAB/ABCA/ABCB comparison; only one contact pair is measurable. The empirical capacitance ratio is 0.772765, while absolute n and the resistance-symmetry D zero remain provisional. Gate coordinates are recorded for later recalibration; no stacking or degeneracy is assumed to set the scale.

**Coverage:** 221 co-swept gate points, nominal n=−1.2…+3.2×10¹² cm⁻² (step 0.02), nominal D=0; TG≈−0.277…+0.984 V and BG≈−0.465…+1.166 V; Si=0. B=0 baseline followed by 1…10 T in 0.2 T steps, 47 rows total. The field grid targets high-field branch topology and will undersample high-index low-field oscillations: do not use it for a low-B FFT; runs 6/7 retain the fine field cuts. Compared with the accessible D=0 interval ~−1.27…+3.26, only endpoint slivers are omitted (full coverage costs ~15 additional minutes). More hole density at D=0 would breach the TG fence and is excluded. This is the requested next fan, not a detour.

**Preconditions and timing:** handoff cells 44/46 report state0 restored, B≈0, kernel BOUND; E1 grant and VERIFY remain valid. Cell 18 SAFETIES exactly matches the card. The cell rechecks all validator ranges without changing them, live thermometry, base T, heaters off, fixed wiring, Si state, 10 nA drive, gate pacing and lock-in τ=0.3 s / 24 dB/oct. It sets sr1 to 100 µV (10 kΩ nominal full scale), uses 3 s interruptible dwell (=10τ), and plots every followed channel. Run 5 measured 1.098 s/point at 1 s dwell and 5.77 s row turnaround. Allowing two-gate writes and field/gate readbacks gives 3.3 s/point: 10,387 points ≈571 min, plus the 0→10 T bare ramp floor 10/0.137≈73 min, plus ≈10 min row/setup overhead. Budget 11 h; revise from landed-row timing. End at 10 T for any descending follow-up.

**Checkpoints:** inspect the first minute's partial digest and first two completed rows (~26 min), then each hour and near 3/6/10 T. Continue only with responsive voltage/current, clean leakage, no clipping and stable thermometry; assess useful fan structure at 3/6 T before spending the remainder. Automatic stops retain the existing 1 nA leakage threshold and flag ≥90% range, drain current outside 8–12 nA, off-base T, stale thermometry or field/gate mismatch. On a safety trip, hold and drop to E0 pending explicit re-grant; on wash-out, stop and price the alternative. **VTI-specific:** a kernel interrupt does not halt a magnet ramp already commanded; notify Zack for a ramp anomaly. No automatic park or repeated field traverse follows interruption.

# Plan step 4: nominal-D=0 Landau fan. Preconditions precede all writes.
import numpy as np
import scipy.constants as _sc

for _name in ('T_sample', 'T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(_name, VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_ts, _tv, _b = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_vsi = k_si()
_ranges = (heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range())
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
print(f'Expected base Ts=1.0..1.5 K, Tv=0.7..1.6 K, |B|<0.02 T, Si=0, heaters off, PS/output on; actual {_ts}, {_tv}, {_b}, {_vsi}, {_ranges}, {_ps}/{_out}')
assert 1.0 <= _ts <= 1.5 and 0.7 <= _tv <= 1.6 and abs(_ts-_tv)<0.6
assert abs(_b)<0.02 and abs(_vsi)<0.01 and _ranges==(0,0) and _ps and _out
for _p, _expected in ((k_tg.volt,(-0.3,1.0)), (k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.0)),
                      (dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.0,25.0)), (dc205.voltage,(-25.0,25.0)),
                      (magnet.field,(-10.0,10.0)), (heater.sample_setpoint,(0.0,100.0)),
                      (heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.0,100.0))):
    _actual=(float(_p.vals._min_value),float(_p.vals._max_value))
    print(f'{_p.full_name} validator expected {_expected}, actual {_actual}')
    assert _actual==_expected
assert B_SESSION_CAP==10 and T_SESSION_CAP==100
assert k_tg is k_2400_tg and k_bg is k_2400_bg and k_si is dc205.smart_voltage
assert WIRING=={'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2','sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
assert meas_config['sr0_gain']==-1e6 and meas_config['bias_resistor']==100e6 and meas_config['bias_channel']=='sr1'
_dc=(dc205.voltage_range(),dc205.output(),dc205.ramp_rate)
print('Expected DC205 (range,output,rate)=(2,1,0.5), actual',_dc)
assert _dc==(2,1,0.5)
_ac=(sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency(),sr0.time_constant(),sr1.time_constant(),sr0.filter_slope(),sr1.filter_slope(),sr0.sensitivity())
print('Expected AC (1 V,13.777 Hz,0.3 s,0.3 s,24,24,0.02 V), actual',_ac)
assert abs(_ac[0]-1)<1e-6 and abs(_ac[1]-13.777)<0.01 and _ac[2:]==(0.3,0.3,24,24,0.02)
print('Gate pacing: expected steps 0.005 V, nplci=1; actual',k_tg.volt.step,k_bg.volt.step,k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci(),'; inter_delays',k_tg.volt.inter_delay,k_bg.volt.inter_delay)
assert k_tg.volt.step==0.005 and k_bg.volt.step==0.005 and k_tg.nplci()==1 and k_bg.nplci()==1

# Explicit run-5 calibration; density in SI internally, display in 1e12 cm^-2.
_fcal=dict(c_tg=0.0027960593093052633,c_bg=0.002160696465377614,n_offset=-0.08937933224099137,D_offset=-0.013)
_fan_n=np.linspace(-1.2,3.2,221)
_q=_sc.e*(_fan_n-_fcal['n_offset'])*1e16
_delta=2*_sc.epsilon_0*(0.0-_fcal['D_offset'])*1e9
_fan_tg=(_q+_delta)/(2*_fcal['c_tg'])
_fan_bg=(_q-_delta)/(2*_fcal['c_bg'])
_fan_B=np.r_[0.0,np.round(np.arange(1.0,10.0001,0.2),4)]
for _p,_vec in ((k_tg.volt,_fan_tg),(k_bg.volt,_fan_bg),(magnet.field,_fan_B)):
    for _v in _vec: _p.validate(float(_v))
    print(f'{_p.full_name} planned {min(_vec):+.6f}..{max(_vec):+.6f}, {len(_vec)} points')
assert len(_fan_B)==47 and len(_fan_n)==221

# Only acquisition-range change; gate/field/T validators and ramp pacing untouched.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
assert sr1.sensitivity()==100e-6
mc=dict(meas_config)
mc.update({'sr1_gain':1.0,'Si (V)':_vsi,'sample_temperature:':_ts,
           'gate_calibration_run5':_fcal,'density_scale_status':'geometry-anchored; CNP ratio empirical; D zero operational',
           'nominal_density_1e12_cm2':_fan_n.tolist(),'nominal_D_V_nm':0.0,
           'point_settle_s':3.0,'sr0_tau_s':_ac[2],'sr1_tau_s':_ac[3],
           'sr0_filter_slope':_ac[4],'sr1_filter_slope':_ac[5],
           'comments':'B_1-B_2 landau-fan: B 0 baseline then 1..10 T step .2; n_geom -1.2..3.2e12 step .02; nominal D0; base T; Si0; 3s settle via before hook'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('plan step 4; B_1-B_2; run-5 CNP calibration, absolute scale geometry prior; B=0 then 1:0.2:10 T; n=-1.2:0.02:3.2 x10^12 cm^-2; Dnom=0 V/nm; Si=0 V; Ibias=10 nA; sr1=100 uV; 3 s=10tau settling; TG/BG co-swept at unchanged pacing')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(_fan_bg[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(_fan_tg[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)
# Columns: time, Bset, TGset, BGset, then the followed values below.
_fan_follow=[T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P,magnet.field,k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt]
for _p in _fan_follow:
    s.fp(_p)
    s.plot('time',_p)
_fan_count=[0]
_fan_trips=[]

def _fan_before(station):
    # Dwell is interruptible; sweep fast_delay=0 avoids a bare blocking sleep.
    interruptible_sleep(3)

def _fan_after(station,data):
    _fan_count[0]+=1
    ts,tv,it,ib,x0,p0,x1,p1,bread,vt,vb=map(float,data[4:])
    issues=[]
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(data)): issues.append('nonfinite read')
    if abs(it)>1e-9 or abs(ib)>1e-9: issues.append(f'gate leakage {it:g}/{ib:g} A')
    if not (1<=ts<=1.5 and 0.7<=tv<=1.6 and abs(ts-tv)<0.6): issues.append(f'off-base T {ts}/{tv}')
    if abs(x0)>=0.9*0.02 or abs(x1)>=0.9*100e-6: issues.append('lock-in range >=90%')
    if not 8e-9 <= x0/(-1e6) <= 12e-9: issues.append(f'drain current {x0/-1e6:g} A')
    if abs(bread-float(data[1]))>0.03: issues.append(f'field readback {bread} vs {data[1]}')
    if abs(vt-float(data[2]))>0.003 or abs(vb-float(data[3]))>0.003: issues.append('gate readback mismatch')
    if _fan_count[0]%221==0:
        try:
            for name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
                assert_thermometry_live(name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
        except Exception as exc: issues.append(f'thermometry liveness: {exc}')
        print(f'FAN ROW {_fan_count[0]//221}/47 complete B={bread:.4f} T, Ts={ts:.3f}, Tv={tv:.3f}')
    if issues:
        _fan_trips.extend(issues)
        print('FAN STOP:', '; '.join(issues),flush=True)
        station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_before(_fan_before,())
s.register_run_after(_fan_after,())
_fan_result=s.multimegasweep([magnet.field],[_fan_B],[k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt],[_fan_tg,_fan_bg],slow_delay=3,fast_delay=0)
print('FAN COMPLETE:',_fan_result.id,'interrupted=',_fan_result.metadata.get('interrupted'), 'trips=',_fan_trips)
print('End state B/TG/BG/Si/Ts/Tv:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt(),k_si(),T_sample(),T_vaporizer())

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).

# === SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0 (region-A calibration), B 0 -> 10 T ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---

# === Kernel-binding probe (read-only) ===
# First E1 act after the grant: confirms the nb-collab execute path lands on the
# operator's instrument-carrying kernel (the one that ran Setup + SAFETIES), not
# a fresh python3 kernel. Touches no instrument — namespace only.
import os
_need = ['magnet', 'heater', 'sr0', 'sr1', 'sr2', 'sr3', 'k_2400_tg', 'k_2400_bg',
         'dc205', 'k_tg', 'k_bg', 'k_si', 'T_sample', 'T_vaporizer', 'meas_config',
         'WIRING', 'state0', 'cal', 'B_SESSION_CAP', 'T_SESSION_CAP', 'tg_lims', 'bg_lims']
_missing = [n for n in _need if n not in globals()]
print(f"pid {os.getpid()} | main_dir {main_dir if 'main_dir' in globals() else '<unset>'}")
print(f"present: {len(_need) - len(_missing)}/{len(_need)} | missing: {_missing}")
print("KERNEL PROBE:", "BOUND" if not _missing else "UNBOUND")
